get_status.description: Station budgets, Mana, floors and big-upload state.

get_app.description: One of Carl's apps: allowance and rolling 24 h use.

get_entry.description: Allowlist entry for a contract + entry point.

quote_allowance.description: Price of a sold daily allowance.

quote_big_upload.description: Price of a big upload and whether the reserve can take it now.

buy_allowance.description: Buy a daily Mana allowance for an app contract (kind 1) or an account (kind 2) for N prepaid days.

renew.description: Extend a sold allowance by one more 1, 7 or 30 day term, paid now at the price CURRENT at renewal

buy_big_upload.description: Buy a one-time big upload (prepaid quoted Mana, expires) for `payee`.

close_ticket.description: After a ticket expires, release its unused Mana from the big-upload debt (anyone).

cancel_allowance.description: Buyer cancels an allowance: unused WHOLE days of every term are refunded from escrow (the current day

cancel_big_upload.description: Buyer cancels a big-upload ticket: unused Mana refunded pro rata, minimum charge 20% of the ticket.

release.description: After a term ends (anyone may call): send the earned, unrefunded amount to Carl (treasury). Once.

owner_refund.description: Owner refunds unused value: an allowance (unused whole days, current day used) or a big-upload ticket

would_pay.description: Would the station pay for this transaction right now? The same rules as the real decision, run without

init.description: First-time setup. Only valid inside the transaction that uploads the station (so nobody can front-run it).

set_app.description: Add or change one of Carl's apps, its allowance and any explicit boost (owner).

set_entry.description: Allow or remove a contract + entry point (owner).

suspend_allowance.description: Suspend a buyer (owner only): every allowance and big-upload ticket that buyer paid for stops being

unsuspend_allowance.description: Lift a buyer's suspension (owner only). Expiry dates are unchanged. Emits station.buyer_unsuspended.

get_suspension.description: A buyer's suspension (empty if not suspended).

set_exempt.description: Add, change or remove a fee-exempt contract (owner only; emits station.exempt_changed).

get_exempt.description: A fee-exempt entry (empty if not exempt).

set_price.description: Set the price for a stablecoin (owner).

connect_app.description: Connect (or update) a free app: it gets mana_per_day of the station's daily budget for its users. Operator.

disconnect_app.description: Disconnect a free app; its daily Mana goes back to the sellable slice. Operator.

list_connected.description: Everything connected: free apps and paid allowances, with today's use and the station's budget.

propose.description: Propose a guarded action (council member `signer`, who also approves it).

cancel_proposal.description: Veto a pending proposal (any ONE council member).

execute.description: Carry out an approved proposal after its delay (anyone). Upgrades instead run by uploading the approved code.
